svg.title: The craft at a glance: gods, forces, schools, elements and the price
svg.desc: LAYER I · THE GODS (Dievai) source, ancient, mostly indifferent Perkūnas · Velnias · Žemyna · Gabija Bangpūtys · Vėjopatis · Praurimė

text.tspan: The craft at a glance: gods, forces, schools, elements and the price
mortal words, mortal blood, mortal cost
bound by Balance, Truth and Memory
bought power (bargains) stand outside the six.
Water · Bangpūtys · full moon, high tide;
THE COST FLOW · immediate element costs and deferred debt are distinct
ends at her Book I ch.
Gods are petitioned; Forces are bargained with and remember every bargain. The Three Laws (Balance, Truth, Memory) bind mortal craft only. [Saga]
